findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "spin_wheel" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_wheel_templates" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
